paragraphs: It is hereby ordered that Passage Key, an island near the mouth of Tampa Bay, Florida, as shown on the General Land Office map of the State of Florida of date 1893, and situated in section 6, township 34 south, range 16 east, as the same appears upon the official plat of survey of said township approved March 17, 1877, be, and it is hereby reserved and set apart for the use of the Department of Agriculture as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds. This reservation to be known as the Passage Key Reservation.
eo-357-b.collated_against: Laws Applicable to the United States Department of Agriculture (GPO, 1908), p. 188, and revised edition (GPO, 1913), p. 211; and Wikisource, 2026-10-12
eo-357-b.notes: Operative text agrees word for word in all three. The GPO printings give the date only in the heading ('Executive order, October 10, 1905') and end with the signature alone; the dateline 'The White House, October 10, 1905.' is Wikisource's, unsourced. Executive order: no seal, not in the Statutes at Large.
